name: Geometric Linear Independence + Dummy Global Constraint
description: Replaces the matrix rank condition with a requirement that vectors V_x, V_y, and W must be linearly independent, perfectly encoding x != y. Explicitly notes that self-loops u=v force linear dependence, addressing the survivor's shortcut. Adds a dummy global capacity constraint to trick models into abandoning MRV backtracking in favor of naive search or ILP, causing timeouts.
